sa: यत् किंचित् कथ्यते लोकेश्रूयते पठ्यतेऽपि वा। सर्वं तद् ब्राह्मणेष्वेव गूढोऽग्निरिव दारुषु॥
en: Like. fire concealed within wood, everything that is said or heard or read in this world, lies in the Brahmana.

sa: तडागानां च वक्ष्यामि कृतानां चापि ये गुणाः। त्रिषु लाकेषु सर्वत्र पूजनीयस्तडागवान्॥
en: The man who causes a tank to be dug becomes entitled to the respect and adoration of the three worlds.

sa: न जात्वस्य च वंशस्य राज्ञां कश्चित् कदाचन। राजाऽऽसीद् यः प्रजापाल: प्रजानामप्रियोऽभवत्।।१५।
en: Indeed, in this royal family, there never was a king who coming to rulc his subjects, became unpopular with them.

sa: निवेशनानां क्षेत्राणां वसतीनां च भारत। दातारः प्रार्थितानां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।।१००।
en: Those men who give houses and fields and populated villages to persons that want them, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: अलर्क उवाच श्रुत्वा तु विविधाञ्शब्दांस्तानेव प्रतिगृध्यति। तस्माच्छ्रोत्रं प्रति शरान् प्रतिमुञ्चाम्यहं शितान्॥
en: Alarka said Hearing various sounds, (the ear) hankers after them only. Hence, I shall discharge wheticd shafts at the ear.

sa: पञ्च पूर्वा हि पुरुषाः षडन्ये वसुधां गताः। एकादश ददद्भूमि परित्रातीह मानवः॥
en: By making a gift of earth one rescues these eleven, viz., five generations of ancestors and six generations of descendants.

sa: भक्षयित्वापि यो मांसं पश्चादपि निवर्तते। तस्यापि सुमहान् धर्मो यः पापाद् विनिवर्तते॥
en: That man who having eaten flesh abstains from it afterwards acquires great merit on account of such abstention from sin.

sa: श्रद्दधानाश्च ये मर्त्या ब्राह्मणेषु महात्मसु। दानमेतत् प्रयच्छन्ति न तेषां विद्यते भयम्॥
en: Those human beings who gifted with faith, make these gifts to great Brahmanas, become freed from fear of every sort.

sa: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यं शृणुयाद् यः पठेत वा। गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुक्तं स मुच्येत् सर्वकिल्बिषैः।।१०६।
en: That person who recites or hears recited this sacred topic of the praise of Ganga, becomes purged of every sin.

sa: य इमां व्याहृतिं वेद ब्राह्मणो वेदसम्मिताम्। श्राद्धस्य क्रियमाणस्य ब्रह्मभूयं स गच्छति॥
en: That Brahmana who recites this great saying of the Vedas at the time of a Shraddha get the highest reward.

sa: नियम्यते तमो यत्र रजस्तत्र प्रवर्तते। नियम्यते रजो यत्र सत्त्वं तत्र प्रवर्तते॥
en: There where Ignorance is restrained, Darkness is seen to flow. There where Darkness is restrained, Goodness is scen to flow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठा राजानं द्रष्टुमभ्ययुः । नारदः पर्वतश्चैव देवलश्च महातपाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Those foremost of ascetics, viz., Narada, Parvata and Devala of Austere penances, came there to see king Dhritarashtra.

sa: पृष्ठतो द्रौपदी चैव सुभद्रां च यशस्विनीम्। सविक्रोशं सकरुणं बान्धवानां स्त्रियो नृप॥
en: Behind her were Draupadi and the famous Subhadra, and the wives of the relatives of the Pandavas, all weeping piteously.

sa: तडागं सुकृतं यस्य वसन्ते तु महाश्रयम्। अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं स समुपाश्नुते॥
en: That man in whose wellmade tank water lies in the season of spring, acquires the merit of the Atiratra sacrifice.

sa: यानि तूभयतो राजन् प्रतप्तानि महान्ति च। तानि युद्धानि वक्ष्यामि कौन्तेयस्य तवाऽनघ॥
en: I shall, O sinless king, describe to you those battles only which were the principal ones among all he fought.

sa: ततः स राजा कुशिकः सभार्यस्तेन कर्मणा॥ विस्मयं परमं प्राप्तस्तद् दृष्ट्वा महदद्भुतम्।
en: Having seen that highly wonderful spectacle and its quick disappearance also, king Kushika, with his wife, became filled with wonder.

sa: वीणानां वल्लकीनां च वेणूनां च विशाम्पते। सुघोषैर्मधुरैः शब्दैः सुप्तः स प्रतिबोध्यते॥
en: He is roused every morning from his bed by the sweet notes of Vinas and Vallakis and flutes, O king.

sa: धर्मराजोऽपि मेधावी श्रुत्वा व्यासस्य तद् वचः। वित्तस्यानयने तात चकार गमने मतिम्॥
en: The intelligent king Yudhishthira, the just, hearing the words of Vyasa, set his mind on the journey for bringing wealth.

sa: ततो नारायणो दृष्ट्वा तानृषीन् विस्मयान्वितान्। प्रश्रितं मधुरं स्निग्धं पप्रच्छ वदतां वरः॥
en: Seeing those Rishis thus stricken with wonder, that foremost of speakers. Narayana, addressed them in these sweet and refreshing words:

sa: चम्पकांस्तिलकांचूतान्प्रसेकान्सिन्दुवारकान्। तिनिशान्करवीरांश्च भजन्ति स्म प्लवङ्गमाः॥ अशोकांश्च करांश्च प्लक्षन्यग्रोधपादपान्। जम्बुकामलकानागन्भजन्ति स्म प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: Those monkeys broke down various treesCampakas, Tilakas, mangoes, Prasekas, Sinduvaras, Tinisas and Karaviras, Asokas, Karanjas, Plaksas, Nyagrodhas, Jambukas and Amalakas.

sa: नास्य वेगगतिं कश्चिन्न च रूपं धनुः शरान्। न नास्य विदितं किंचित्सूर्यस्येवाभ्रसंप्लवे॥
en: Like to the sun hidden in clouds they could see neither his countenance and motion, nor his bow and arrows.

sa: अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरी सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्॥ अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा।
en: Beholding the city of Kişkindhā, ruled over by Vālī, Sitā, incited by her love, addressed Rāma, with worthy words, saying

sa: सर्वमेव हि लोकेशो धाता गोप्ता न संशयः। नैवंविधं महद्भूतं विद्यते भुवनत्रये॥
en: Forsooth he is the creator and the preserver of the universe, there is none so wonderful in the three worlds.

sa: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम् । मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतां विना॥
en: What greater grief can there be, O Saumitri, that I behold the jewel obtained from the ocean but not Vaidehi.?

sa: भक्त्या रामस्य ये चेमा संहितामृषिणा कृताम्। ये लिखन्तीह च नरास्तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: Those, who shall write this story of Rāma first recorded by the Rși (Vālmīki) shall reach the region of Brahma.

sa: सर्वान् भोगान् परित्यज्य भर्तृस्नेहबलात् कृता । अचिन्तयित्वा कष्टानि प्रविष्टा निर्जनं वनम्॥
en: Renouncing all luxuries, and considering not the least about miseries, she actuated by her husband's love entered the solitary forest.

sa: अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितोऽस्मि विभीषण। मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः सखे त्वां चानुमानये॥
en: Do you regard me, O Vibhīşaņa, O gentle one, as worshipped. O friend do you be not angry-I request you.

sa: इमौ ताविति संचिन्त्य सज्यं कृत्वा च कार्मुकम्। संततानिषुधाराभिः पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥
en: Thinking "these must be both brothers, Rāma and Lakşmaņa," and stretching his bow he began showering arrows like to clouds.

sa: अधोभागे तु मे दृष्टिः शोचतः पतिता तदा। तत्राद्राक्षमहं भीमां राक्षसी सलिलेशयाम्॥
en: And as I stood aggrieved, my glance fell downwards. Then I saw there a dreadful Räksasī supine on the flood.

sa: रमस्व राजन्पिब चाद्य वारुणीं कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीय दुःखम्। मयाद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयं चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ॥
en: Make merry, my king; today drink Varuni. Enjoy pleasures, banishing sorrow. And today on my having despatched Rāma to the mansion of Yama, Sītā shall come under your control for good.

sa: तं विना कैकयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणाम्। न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च॥
en: Without Bharata the son of Kaikeyi, ever performing pious rites, I do not value bathing or these clothes and ornaments.

sa: सोऽब्रवीत्स्नेहसंयुक्तं मरुत्तं तं महानृषिः। श्रोतव्यं यदि मद्वाक्यं संप्रहारो न ते क्षमः॥
en: And that great sage said to Marutta words informed with affection 'If you hear my speech, you should not fight.

sa: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः। ऋक्षराजो महाबाहुः कुक्षिं रक्षन्तु ते त्रयः॥
en: And let that king of bears, the long-armed Jāmbavān, Sușeņa, and the monkey, Vegadarci, protect the rear (of the forces).

sa: नूनं लङ्का हते पापे रावणे राक्षसाधिये। शोषमेष्यति दुर्धर्षा प्रमदा विधवा यथा॥
en: The lord of the Rākşasas, the vicious Rāvana being killed, forsooth shall Lankā, divested of wealth, appear like a widow.

sa: स त्वमिक्ष्वाकुनाथं वै क्षिपनिह न लज्जसे। चक्षुषो विषये तस्य न यावदुपगच्छसि॥
en: You are not ashamed of railing that lord of Ikşvākus, so long as dose you not come within his ken.

sa: ततः शैलोपमं वीरं प्राञ्जलिं प्रणतं स्थितम्। उवाचेदं वचो रामो हनूमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma spoke to the heroic monkey Hanumān, resembling a mountain and standing before him humbly with folded hands saying.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति यामन्यां बलान्नारों गमिष्यसि। तदा ते शतधा मूर्धा फलिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: If from this day, you ravish a female by force, your head certainly shall be riven in an hundred pieces.

sa: तासां मध्यगतो राजा रराज न तदार्जुनः। करेणूनां सहस्रस्य मध्यस्थ इव कुञ्जरः॥
en: And being encircled by them the king Arjuna appeared like a leading elephant surrounded by a thousands of she elephants.

sa: (शतं खर्वसहस्राणां महाखर्वमिति स्मृतम्।) महाखर्व सहस्राणां समुद्रमभिधीयते। शतं समुद्रसाहस्रं महौघमिति विश्रुतम्॥ एवं कोटिसहस्रेण शकूनां च शतेन च।
en: An hundred of a thousand Kharva is termed a Mahākharva, and hundred of a thousand Mahākharva is termed a Samudra. An hundred of a thousand Samudra is known as a Mahaugha.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि सोऽहं यद्भुक्तं वनं तैः कृतकर्मभिः॥ धर्षितं मर्षणीयं च चेष्टितं कृतकर्मणाम्। गच्छ शीघ्रं मधुवनं संरक्षस्व त्वमेव हि। शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तान् हनूमत्प्रमुखान् कपीन्॥
en: Greatly pleased I am, since, they, being successful, have explored this forest. And the insulting procedure of the successful is also pardonable. Do you soon go there and protect that orchards, and send here all those monkeys headed by Hanumān.

sa: शरेणैकेन च हरीन्नव पञ्च च सप्त च। बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धो राक्षसान्संप्रहर्षयन्॥
en: Fired with wrath, that (hero) rejoicing the Rākṣasas with a single shaft pierced nine and seven monkeys in that encounter.

sa: साधु घातय मां क्षिप्रं रामस्योपरि रावण। समानय पति पत्न्या कुरु कल्याणमुत्ततमम्॥
en: Do you, O Ravana, speedily slay me upon Rāma; and, bringing the wife to the husband, compass my best benefit.

sa: नैव रात्रिं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न च क्षणम्। रामरावणयोर्युद्ध विराममुपगच्छति॥
en: Neither for the night nor for the day, nor for a moment did the fight between Rāma and Rāvaņa cease.

sa: शीघ्रं भेरीनिनादेन स्फुटं कोणाहतेन मे। समानयध्वं सैन्यानि वक्तव्यं च न कारणम्॥
en: Do you speedily summon my forces with the beat of drums—not do you give out the reason (of the summons).

sa: मम मातुर्वरो दत्तो मन्दरे विश्वकर्मणा। मया तु सदृशः पुत्रस्तव देवि भविष्यति।४७।।
en: (Formerly) in Mandara, Visvakarma had conferred a boon on my mother: 'O exalted one, your son shall be like me.

sa: यथा च स महाबाहुर्ले तारयति राघवः। अस्माद् दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात् त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ॥
en: And it behove you so to compass things that the mighty-armed Rāghava may rescue me from this sea of sorrow.

sa: शक्त्यष्टिपाशहस्तानां सध्वजानां पताकिनाम्॥ तुरगाणां सहस्रैश्च मुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः। पदातीनां सहस्त्रैश्च वीराः परिवृता ययुः॥
en: Some heroes proceeded encircled by thousand excellent steeds and persons carrying Sakti, Rşti, maces and pennons and thousands of infantry.

sa: हरयो मधुना मत्ताः केचित् सुप्ता महीतले। धृष्टाः केचिद्धसन्त्यन्ये केचिद् कुर्वन्ति चेतरत्॥
en: Some of the monkeys, inebriate with honey, slept on the earth; some laughed at others impudently and some cried aloud.

sa: ताभ्यां तु धनुषि श्रेष्ठे संहितौ सायकोत्तमौ। विकृष्यमाणौ वीराभ्यां भृशं जज्वलतुः श्रिया।५०॥
en: On those foremost of shafts set on those excellent bows of those heroes, being drawn, flamed up in exceeding splendour.

sa: दशग्रीवस्तु तं जित्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः। आरुह्य पुष्पकं भूयो निष्क्रान्तो यमसादनात्॥
en: Having vanquished him and distinguished his name, Rāvaņa again ascended his Puşpaka and went out of the abode of Yama.

sa: यदि रामः समुद्रान्तां मेदिनी परिवर्तयेत्। अस्याः कृते जगच्चापि युक्तमित्येव मे मतिः॥
en: And methinks it would have been all proper had Rāma turned on her account the whole earth bounded by oceans.

sa: यज्ञभूम्यां ततो गत्वा पावकस्तेन रक्षसा ॥ हूयमानः प्रजज्वाल होमशोणितमुक्तदा। साचिः पिनद्धो ददृशे होमशोणिततर्पितः।। संध्यागत इवादित्यः सुतीव्रोऽग्निः समुत्थितः॥
en: Reaching there Indrajit lighted up fire and began to pour oblations therein. And the fire blazed up receiving oblations of blood, and being satisfied assumed the appearance of the setting sun.

sa: लङ्कां प्रशाधि धर्मेण धर्मज्ञस्त्वं मतो मम। पुरस्य राक्षसानां च भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य च॥ मा च बुद्धिमधर्मे त्वं कुर्या राजन्कथंचन। बुद्धिमन्तो हि राजानो ध्रुवमश्नन्ति मेदिनीम्॥
en: I know, you are cognisant of piety; the citizens, your councillors and your brother Kubera also love you; do you therefore go and govern Lankā piously, O king; never cherish any vile intention; the honest kings always enjoy the earth.

sa: ध्रुवं मां प्रातराशार्थं राक्षस: कल्पयिष्यति। साहं कथं करिष्यामि तं बिना प्रियदर्शनम्॥
en: Forsooth shall the Raksasa serve me for his morning meal. What shall I do without my lord of comely presence?

sa: श्रुत्वा तु सूर्यस्तद्वृत्तं दण्डिनो रावणस्य ह॥ उवाच वचनं धीमान्बुद्धिपूर्वं क्षपापहः। गच्छ दण्डिञ्जयस्वैनं निर्जितोऽस्मीति वा वद॥ यत्तेभिकाङ्कितं कार्षीः कंचित्कालं क्षपाचरम्। स गत्वा वचनात्तस्य राक्षसस्य महात्मनः॥ कथयामास तत्सर्वं सूर्योक्तवचनं तदा। स श्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य दण्डिनो राक्षसेश्वरः। घोषयित्वा जगामाथ स्वजयं राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Hearing of Rāvana's intention from Dandi the intelligent sun, the enemy of night, wisely said to him, ''Do you proceed, O Dandi; either defeat Rāvaņa or tell him 'I have been defeated.' Do whatever you wish.” Hearing those words he approached the high-souled Rāksasa and communicated to him what the sun had said. Hearing the words of Dandi the lord of Rākşasas trumpeted his own victory and went away.

sa: ततो रोषपरीतात्मा धनुस्तस्य दुरात्मनः। बभञ्ज तरसा नीलो ननाद च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Then his-soul surcharged with wrath, Nīla swiftly shattered the bow of that wicked-minded one, and then shouted again and again.

sa: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण बृस्यां समुपवेशितः। आचचक्षे ततः सर्व रामस्य चरितं वने॥
en: Being thus accosted by the prince and seated on Kusa, he, thereupon, began to describe Rama's life in the forest.

sa: पृथक्स्त्रीणां प्रचारेण जाति त्वं परिशङ्कसे। परित्यजैनां शङ्कां तु यदि तेऽहं परीक्षिता॥
en: Seeing the ordinary women you are distrusting the whole sex. Do you renounce this suspicion since you have tried me.

sa: न विनश्येत् कथं कार्यं वैक्लव्यं न कथं मम। लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत्॥ कथं नु खलु वाक्यं मे शृणुयानोद्विजेत च। इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांश्चकार मतिमान् मतिम्॥
en: What shall I do, by which my work is not injured, I am not blamed of foolishness and my crossing over the main dose not become fruitless? What shall I do so that Sītā might listen to me without being terrified? Thinking over this, the intelligent Hanumān arrived at a conclusion.

sa: अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरी सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्॥ अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा।
en: Beholding the city of Kişkindhā, ruled over by Vālī, Sitā, incited by her love, addressed Rāma, with worthy words, saying

sa: ततश्चण्डोदरी नाम राक्षसी क्रूरदर्शना॥ भ्रामयन्ती महच्छूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। इमां हरिणशावाक्षीं त्रासोत्कम्पपयोधराम्॥ रावणेन हतां दृष्ट्वा दौर्हदो मे महानयम्। यकृत्प्लीहं महत् क्रोडं हृदयं च सबन्धनम्॥ गावाण्यपि तथा शीर्षं खादेयमिति मे मतिः।
en: Thereupon another grim-visaged Rākşasī, named, Candodarī, shaking her terrible spear, said-“Beholding this Sitā having the eyes of a young antelope and her breast trembling with fear, my earnest desire, as I am enciente, has been to banquet on her large eyes, lever, spleen, her plump hands, heart, other limbs and head."

sa: एवं सर्वमशेषेण रावणान्तःपुरं कपिः। ददर्श स महातेजा न ददर्श च जानकीम्॥
en: Thus that highly energetic monkey saw everything thoroughly in the inner apartment of Ravana, but he saw not Janaka's daughter.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ददौ तेभ्यो भूषणानि यथार्हतः। वज्राणि च महाणि सस्वजे च नरर्षभः॥
en: Saying this Rāma, the foremost of men, conferred upon them dully many precious clothes and ornaments and embraced them all.

sa: स तु तं छादयामास नीहार इव भास्करम्। राक्षसाः सत्त्वसंपन्नाः पुनधैर्य समादधुः॥
en: As a mist envelops the Sun, he enveloped him (with his arrows). Thereat, the Rākşasas again summoned up their fortitude.

sa: अभिमन्युस्तु संक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। विव्याध निशितैः षड्भिः सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः।।३३।
en: Thereupon waxing worth Abhimanyu that mighty car-warrior pierced Lakshmana of auspicious marks and his charioteer, with six well sharpened arrows.

sa: यं यं प्रमथते द्रोणः पञ्चलानां रथव्रजम्। तत्र तत्र तु पाञ्चाल्यो धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the Panchala prince, proceeded to those spots where soever Drona sought to assail the car divisions of the Panchalas.

sa: सेनाबिन्दुश्च राजेन्द्र क्रोधहन्ता च नामतः। यः समो वासुदेवेन भीमसेनेन वा विभो॥
en: Senabindu, O chief among kings, and he who is named 'Krodhahanta who is equal to Vasudeva or Bhimasena, O lord,

sa: कोष्ठीकृत्य च तं वीरं धार्तराष्ट्रा महारथाः। एकं सुबहवो युद्धे ततक्षुः सायकैदृढम्॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior of the Dhritarashtra's host encircling that single hero, began to pierce him forcibly with many arrows.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शिखण्डिवाक्यं श्रुत्वाऽथ स यक्षो भरतर्षभ। प्रोवाच मनसा चिन्त्य दैवेनोपनिपीडितः॥
en: Bhishma said At length the Yaksha, hearing the words of Shikhandin, said, afflicted by destiny, after considering in his mind,

sa: स तया निहतो राजन् कालिङ्गत्तनयो रथात्॥ सध्वजः सह सूतेन जगाम धरणीतलम्।
en: Killed by that fearful mace, O king, the son of the Kalinga king fell down with his standard and charioteer.

sa: अलङ्कारैः कवचैः केतुभिश्च सुखप्रणादैहेषितैर्वा हयानाम्। भ्राजिष्मती दुष्प्रतिवीक्षणीया येषां चमूस्ते विजयन्ति शत्रून्॥
en: Those, whose ornaments, armours and standards and their bright shields become incapable of being stared at, always conquei their enemies.

sa: दुःशासनोऽषि परया शक्त्या पार्थमवारयत्। कथं भीष्मं न नो हन्यादिति निश्चित्य भारत॥
en: But Dushasana resisted Partha to the best of this powers, determined, O Bharata, that the latter might hot slay Bhishma.

sa: आनीयतां स्थूण इति ततो यक्षाधिपोऽब्रवीत्। कर्तास्मि निग्रहं तस्य प्रत्युवाच पुनः पुनः॥
en: "Let Sthuna be brought, I shall inflict punishment on him." Said thus the lord of the Yakshas again and again.

sa: अवमन्यसे मां नृपते नूनं दुर्मन्त्रितं तव। यन्मे कन्यां स्वकन्यार्थते मोहाद् याचितवानसि॥
en: "You have insulted me. Surely it was not considerately done that you wanted my daughter for your daughter from folly.

sa: अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्। यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम॥
en: It is called unmanifested and indestructible; they call it the highest goal. Attaining to it, none has to come back,

sa: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्। सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः॥
en: Know me, Partha, as Brihaspati among family priests, and Skanda among commanders of forces. I am occan among all waters.

sa: पीड्यमानाः शरै राजन् द्रोणचापविनिः सृतैः। न शेकुः प्रमुख स्थातुं भारद्वाजस्य पाण्डवाः॥
en: Afflicted, O king, with the shafts shot upon Drona's bow, the Pandavas could not stand in front of Bharadvaja son.

sa: रथी च समरे राजन्नासाद्य गजयूथपम्। सगजं पातयामास गजी च रथिनां वरम्॥
en: O king, car-warriors, getting elephants riders within reach cut them down with the elephants. elephants riders also cut down carwarriors.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन केतुं तस्य महात्मनः। रथश्रेष्ठो रथात् तूर्णं भूमौ पार्थो न्यपातयत्॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors namely the son of Pritha, with another broad-headed shafts, quickly felled on the illustrious Shrutayush.

sa: यद् यद् विभूतमत् सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा। तत् तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोऽशसम्भवम्॥
en: Whatever thing there is of power of glory or splendor, know them to be produced from portions of my energy.

sa: तथैव नकुलं शूरं किरन्तं सायकान् बहून्॥ विकर्णो वारयामास इच्छन् भीष्मस्य जीवितम्।
en: Then Vikarna, desirous of protecting the life of Bhishma checked the heroic Nakula who had been shooting myriads of shafts.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे। श्रुतायुषमभिप्रेक्ष्य प्रेषयामास वाजिनः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then when the sun shone on the meridian, king Yudhishthira, beholding Shrutayush, urged his own steeds towards him.

sa: सहदेवं तथा राजन् यान्तं भीष्मरथं प्रति॥ वारयामास संक्रुद्धः कृपः शारद्वतो युधि।
en: Then Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, wrought up with rage, checked, in battle, Sahadeva proceeding towards the car of Bhishma.

sa: कन्यां प्रवररूपां तु प्राजायत नराधिपा अपुत्रस्य तु राज्ञः सा दुपदस्य मनस्विनी॥
en: Even that lady of great force of mind, O lord of men, gave birth to a daughter of great beauty.

sa: श्वेतो ग्रहस्तथा चित्रां समतिक्रम्य तिष्ठति। अभावं हि विशेषेण कुरूणां तत्र पश्यति॥
en: Ketu (the white planet) stops on passing beyond the constellation Chitra. All this forebodes the total destruction of the Kurus.

sa: इति पार्थं प्रशस्याथ प्रगृह्यान्यन्महद् धनुः। मुमोच समरे वीरः शरान् पार्थरथं प्रति॥
en: Having thus praised Partha, and having taken up a large bow, that great hero hurled his arrows at Partha's car.

sa: गोपाल इव दण्डेन यथा पशुगणान् वने। आवेष्टयत नां सेनां भगदत्तस्तथा मुहुः॥
en: Like a cow-hcard belabouring with his cudgel the herd in the forest. Bhagadatta began to smite the hostile troops repeatedly.

sa: न हि कश्चित् क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्। कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः॥
en: None ever remains for a moment without performing some action. All perform actions impelled by the qualities (laws) of Nature.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पुनरेव सुतस्तव। मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पितामहमपृच्छत॥
en: Sanjaya said When the night had dawned, your son again, in the midst of all the army, asked his Grandsire.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तव पिता तूष्णीमासीद् विशाम्पते। व्यसर्जयच्च राजान शयनं च विवेश ह॥
en: Having spoken thus, O ruler of men, your father became silent; and dismissing the king, he entered his own tent.

sa: हिरण्यवर्मेति नृपो योऽसौ दाशार्णकः स्मृतः। स च प्रादान्महीपालः कन्यां तस्मै शिखण्डिने।॥
en: That king Dasharnaka, known Hiranyavarman (or the golden-armoured) even that ruler of earth gave away his daughter to that Shikhandin.

sa: न पाण्डवान् प्रतिबलांस्तव मन्ये कथंचन। तथा द्रोणस्य संग्रामे द्रौणेश्चैव कृपस्य च॥
en: I do not consider the Pandavas a match for you, or for Drona or for Drona's son or for Kripa.

sa: अब्रवीत् पितरं मातुः सा तदा होत्रवाहनम्। अभिवादयित्वा शिरसा गमिष्ये तव शासनात्॥
en: And saluting with her head the father of her mother, Hotravahana, she said "By your command I shall go there.

sa: सोऽहं तीव्राणि दुःखानि दुर्योधनकृतानि च। श्रोष्यामि सततं तात दुःसहानि बहूनि च॥
en: So, O son, I am always hearing of numerous causes of insufferable and poignant grief, engendered by misdeeds of Duryodhana.

sa: तथैव च चमू सर्वां पाण्डवानां महारथः। अप्रैषीत् स शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः परलोकाय मारिष॥
en: That mighty car-warrior also dispatched the forces of the Pandavas to the other world, O sire, with his sharp-pointed shafts.

sa: भीमं च युयुधानं च पाण्डवः च धनंजयम्। द्वितीयं प्रेषयामास बलस्कन्धं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And then he sent forth the second division of the army with Bhima, Yuyudhana and Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu.

sa: रन्तिदेवस्य यत् किंचित् सौवर्णमभवत् तदा॥ तत् सर्वे वितते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत।
en: Whatever of gold Ratindeva possessed, then, was given away to the Brahmanas in the course of one of his sacrifices.

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते पाण्डवाः सर्वे सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। ताड्यमानासु भेरीषु मृदङ्गेष्वानकेषु च।॥
en: Sanjaya said Then towards the hour of sunrise, all the Pandava warriors, with the sound of drums, cymbals and Anakas,

sa: सहस्रं वामनान् कुब्जान् नक्रान् मकरकच्छपान्। सौवर्णान् विहितान् दृष्ट्वा ततोऽस्मयत वै तदा॥
en: Then king Suhotra beholding thousands of dwarfs hunch-backs, alligators and sharks and tortoises, all made of gold, was greatly amazed.

sa: भीम उवाच अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ सात्यकिः। पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्यास्तथा सर्वे प्रभद्रकाः॥
en: Bhima said will follow you. also will Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki and the Panchalas, the Kekayas, the Matsyas and the Prabhadrakas.

sa: ततः शिखण्डी पाञ्चाल्यः पुंस्त्वमासाद्य पार्थिव विवेश नगरं हृष्टः पितरं च समासदत्॥
en: Thereupon Shikhandin, the Panchalya, having obtained manhood, O king, entered the city and went to his father with great joy.

sa: ततो भीमो महेष्वासः फाल्गुनश्च महारथः। कौरवाणां चमू घोरां भृशं दुद्रुवतू रणे॥
en: Then the fierce bowman Bhima and the mighty car-warrior Phalguna began to crush severely the dreadful army of the Kurus.

sa: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव। न ह्यसंन्यस्तसंकल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन॥
en: To the devotees who are free from desire and wrath, and a Yogi who has not renounced all his resolves.

sa: द्रावयित्वा चमू राजन् वैराटिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥ आपतत् सहसा भूयो यत्र भीष्मो व्यवस्थितः।
en: O king, having routed your army, Virata's son (Shveta) senseless in anger again rushed towards the place where Bhishma stood.

sa: व्यास उवाच एतच्छुत्वार्थवद् वाक्यं नारदेन प्रकाशितम्। उवाचाकम्पनो राजा सखायं नारदं तथा॥
en: Vyasa said Having heard these words of grave signification uttered by Narada, Narada, king Akampana, addressing his friend Narada said-

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते पार्थिवाः क्रुद्धाः फाल्गुनं वीक्ष्य संयुगे। रथैरनेकसाहौः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having seen Arjuna in battle, the kings angrily surrounded him on all sides with many thousands of cars.

sa: स त धैर्मेण तं कोपं संनिवार्य महायशाः। श्रुतायुषः प्रचिच्छेद मुष्टिदेशे महाधनुः॥
en: But that highly-renowned (Yudhishthira) restraining that wrath of his, with patience, served the mighty bow of Shrutayush near the grasp.

sa: प्रविश्य च पुरी वीरः समासाद्य युधिष्ठिरम्। आचष्ट तद् यथावृत्तं वृष्ण्यन्धककुलं प्रति॥
en: Entering it, the hero approached Yudhishthira and informed him of all that had taken place about the Vrishnis. JSALA PARVA

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु तत्त्वेन राजेन्द्र कीर्त्यमानं मयानघ। वासुदेवं पुरस्कृत्य यदकुर्वत पाण्डवाः॥
en: Hear me, O king, as I narrate fully, O sinless one, what the Pandavas, headed by Vasudeva did after this.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं तदभवद् युद्धं तुमुलं जनमेजय। यत्र दुःखान्वितो राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Thus, O Janamejaya, did that terrible battle take place. King Dhritarashtra, in great sorrow, said thus about it.

sa: अहंकारस्य यः स्रष्टा सर्वभूतभवाय वै। यतः समभवद् विश्वं पृष्टोऽहं यदिह त्वया॥
en: Asked by you I have now told you of Him who created objects, and from whom this universe had originated.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विश्वामित्रस्य विप्रर्वसिष्ठस्य च भारत। भृशं वैरमभूद् राजंस्तपः स्पर्धाकृतं महत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said A great enemity arose between Vishvamitra and Vashishtha, O Bharata, on account of their rivalry regarding ascetic penances.

sa: इन्द्रद्युम्नो हतः कोपाद् यवनश्च कसेरुमान्। हतः सौभपतिः शाल्वस्त्वया सौभं च पातितम्॥
en: You killed in fury Indradyumna and the Yavana called Kaseruman. Killing Shalva, the king of Saivya, you destroyed his city.

sa: प्रार्थयन्ते परं लोके स्थाणुमेकं स सर्वकृत्॥ स एष रुद्रभक्तश्च केशवो रुद्रसम्भवः। कृष्ण एव हि यष्टव्यो यज्ञैश्चैव सनातनः॥
en: With a view to obtain that highest object in the world viz., Sthanu or Mahadeva; He is the creator of all. The eternal Krishna ought to be adored in all sacrifices.

sa: सत्येन संवर्धयति यो दमेन शमेन च। अहिंसया च दानेन तप्यमानः सनातनः॥
en: He grows with truth, self-respect, tranquillity of heat, mercy, and gifts. He is always engaged in penances, and is eternal.

sa: तं भवान् मदपेश्चार्थ विधिवत् प्रतिपूजयेत्। स तु भक्तोऽनुरक्तश्च मम नित्यमिति प्रभो॥
en: Do you honour him duly for my sake, O powerful one, he is always attached and deeply devoted to me.

sa: यदाभिमन्युं बहवो युद्दे जघ्नुर्महारथाः। परिवार्य रणे बालं क्क ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When encircling the boy Abhimanyu in battle a number of powerful car-warriors killed him where was the virtue of yours.

sa: हत्वा हिडिम्बं भीमोऽथ प्रस्थितो भ्रातृभिः सह। हिडिम्बामग्रतः कृत्वा यस्यां जातो घटोत्कचः॥
en: Having thus killed Hidimba, Bhima proceeded with his brothers, placing Hidimba in their front, (Hidimba) of whom Ghatotkacha was born.

sa: राजर्षयोऽपि ते स्वर्यो धर्मो ह्येषां निरुच्यते। यथैव पूर्णादुदधेः स्यन्दन्त्यापो दिशो दश॥
en: Like water flowing on every direction from a rising ocean, wealth goes on all sides from the treasuries of kings.

sa: नन्विमे शरणं प्राप्तं न त्यजन्ति कदाचन। ते मां शरणमापन्नां नान्वपद्यन्त पाण्डवाः॥
en: The Pandavas never forsake the persons who ask for their protection, but they abandoned me who asked for their protection.

sa: पार्थः पञ्च च षष्टिं च वर्षाणि श्वेतवाहनः॥ महावीर्यं महादिव्यमेतत् तद् धनुरुत्तमम्।
en: And lastly Partha, having white steeds, has held, for sixty five years, this highly powerful, heavenly and most excellent bow.

sa: त्वरध्वं सर्वतो यत्ता राधेयस्य रथं प्रति। ततस्तव सुता राजञ्छ्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्वचो द्रुतम्॥
en: “Hie yourselves quickly near the car of Pandu's son.” Thereupon, o king, your sons hearing those words of your son.

sa: यदा शरशतैः पार्थो दर्प तव वधिष्यति। तदा त्वमन्तरं द्रष्टा आत्मनंश्चार्जुनस्य त॥
en: When Partha with hundreds of shafts break down you pride you will then see the difference between yourself and Dhananjaya.

sa: सर्वथा हतमेवेदं कौरवाणां महद् बलम्। न ह्यस्य विद्यते त्राता साक्षादपि पुरंदरः॥
en: The son of Pandu has totally destroyed my vast army. (I think) even Purandara himself in person cannot protect it.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते तु संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। कौरवेयांस्त्रिधाभूतान् पाण्डवा: समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus when that horripilating battle was progressing on, the Pandavas rushed against the Kauravas divided into three bodies.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं विशाम्पते॥ कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च लिप्सतां सुमहद् यशः।
en: Then a dreadful encounter took place between the Kurus and Pandavas who were actuated by the desire of gaining glory.

sa: त्वया चैवं व्रतं पार्थ बालेनेव कृतं पुरा। तस्मादधर्मसंयुक्तं मौात् कर्म व्यवस्यसि॥
en: You had formerly taken the vow through childishness. And now through folly you are inclined to do an unrighteous act.

sa: एतान् पश्य च पञ्चालान् द्राव्यमाणान् महारथान्। शक्रेणेव यथा दैत्यान् हन्यमानान् महाहवे॥
en: There the powerful Panchala car-warriors are being dispersed (by him) like the Daityas slain by Sakra in the great battle.

sa: एष कर्णो रणे जित्वा पञ्चालान् पाण्डुसृञ्जयान्। दिशो विप्रेक्षते सर्वास्त्वदर्थमिति मे मतिः॥
en: Having defeated the Panchalas, Pandavas and Srinjayas, Karna is casting his eyes on all sides, methinks, for finding you out.

sa: ततो भीम रणश्लाघी छादयामास पत्रिभिः॥ कर्णं रणे महाराज पुत्राणां तव पश्यताम्।
en: Then boasting of his power in battle, O king, Bhima covered Karna with Naracha in the presence of your sons.

sa: बाह्निकाभ्याशतो युक्तं कर्णस्य च महद् बलम्। अन्योन्येन हि सैन्यानि भिन्नान्येतानि सारथे॥
en: O charioteer, though these divisions are distinct from one another, yet depending on one another, they are supporting one another.

sa: तेषां तु रथमुख्यानां रथेषु विविधा ध्वजाः। प्रत्यदृश्यन्त राजेन्द्र ज्वलिता इव पावकाः॥
en: O king, on the chariots of those foremost of car-warriors were seen various kinds of standards shining like blazing fire.

sa: ते हन्यमानाः समरे पञ्चालाः सोमकास्तथा॥ परित्यज्य रणे द्रौणिं व्यद्रवन्त दिशो दश।
en: Sore oppressed in battle, the Panchalas and the Somakas, abandoning the son of Drona, took to flight in ten directions.

sa: भगदत्तं च राजानं कोऽन्यः शक्तसत्वया बिना। जेतुं पुरुषशार्दूल योऽपि स्याद् वासवोपमः॥
en: O mighty one, who else, excepting yourself, could have conquered Bhagadatta in fight, even were he powerful like Vasava himself.

sa: त्वां च दृष्ट्वातिसंरब्धं कर्णं च भरतर्षभ। असौ दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धो नोत्तरं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Seeing you greatly worked up with anger and Karna too Duryodhiana, although angered, will not be able to do anything.

sa: नैव नस्तादृशं युद्धं दृष्टपूर्वं न च श्रुतम्॥ यथा सूर्योदये राजन् समुत्पिञ्जोऽभवन्महान्।
en: We never saw nor heard of such a battle before as, O king, was fought during that hour of sun-rise.

sa: तस्मात् त्वं मत्प्रियं कुर्वन् याहि यत्र युधिष्ठिरः। दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं युद्धे धर्मपुत्रं सहानुजम्॥ पुनर्योद्धास्मि वार्ष्णेय शत्रुभिः सं संयुगे।
en: If you wish to do me a good turn proceed where Yudhishthira is engaged. If I see Dharma's son and his younger brother well, I will fight again with the enemies.

sa: कृपं विव्याध विंशत्या कर्ण पञ्चाशता शरैः॥ शल्यं दुर्योधनं चैव षभिः षड्भिरताडयत्।
en: He pierced Kripa with twenty and Karna with fifty shafts; he then wounded Shalya and Duryodhana each with six shafts.

sa: पुष्पाणीव विचिन्वन् हि सोत्तमाङ्गान्यपातयत्। ते रथेभ्यो हताः पेतुः क्षितौ राजन् सुवर्चसः॥
en: Felled their heads, like one culling flowers. O king, those radiant heroes then fell down slain from their respective cars.

sa: कर्णो हि भाषते नित्यमहं पार्थान् समागतान्॥ वासुदेवं च दाशार्ह विजेष्यामि महारथम्।
en: Karna also often says that, “I will conquer the assembled Parthas and Vasudeva, that valiant charioteer of Dasharha's race. roars

sa: अद्य कृष्ण विकर्णा मे कर्णं नेष्यन्ति मृत्यवे। गाण्डीवमुक्ताः क्षिण्वन्तो मम हस्तप्रचोदिताः॥
en: Today, O Krishna, pointed arrows flung from Gandiva and sped by my arms, will sent Karna to his last account.

sa: अद्य राज्यात् सुखाश्चैव श्रियो राष्ट्रात् तथा पुरात्। पुत्रेभ्यश्च महाबाहो धृतराष्ट्रो विमोक्ष्यति॥
en: O large-arined one, today King Dhritarashtra will be deprived of his sovereignty and happiness, wealth and dominion, capital and sons.

sa: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हेमचित्रं महाधनम्। प्राविशन् धरणी भित्त्वा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Penetrating through his precious armour ornamented with gold, those fierce shafts entered into the earth like snakes (entering into) ant-hill.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अत्यद्भुमहं मन्ये भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्। यत् कर्ण योधयामास समरे लघुविक्रमम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said Indeed I consider Bhima's prowess to be very wonderful, inasmuch as he fought with Karna of great agility.

sa: प्राक्रोशन् भीमसेनं ते धृष्टद्युम्नं च भारत। दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्य कर्माणि तथारूपाणि मारिष॥
en: Beholding those terrible feats of Drona, 0) sire they began to exclaim aloud saying, 'O Bharata,' 'Oh Bhimasena,; 'O Dhrishtadyumna.'

sa: ततस्तौ निहतौ दृष्ट्वा तयो राजन् पदानुगाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धाः किरन्तः शतशः शरान्॥
en: Then, O king, beholding those two heroes slain, their followers inflamed with rage, rushed against Arjuna, discharging arrows by thousands.

sa: तस्य कोपं समुद्वीक्ष्य चित्तज्ञः केशवास्तदा। उवाच किमिदं पार्थ गृहीतः खङ्ग इत्युत॥
en: Kesava, the cogniser of human hearts, seeing his rage, inquired-"Why, O Partha, do you lay your hands on your sword?

sa: पुनश्च शरवर्षाणि घोराण्युग्राणि पाण्डवः। व्यसृजद् बलवान् क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्रवधेप्सया॥ ततोऽसमायया तूर्णं शरवृष्टिं निवार्य ताम्। धनुश्चिच्छेद भीमस्य द्रोणपुत्रो महास्त्रवित्॥
en: Thereupon, Drona's son, acquainted with the use of the most excellent weapons, soon destroying that arrowy shower by the illusive force of his own weapons, cut-off Bhima's bow in that battle.

sa: वैहायसं प्राक्रमद् वै कर्णस्य व्यथयन्मनः। स तस्य चरितं दृष्ट्वा संग्रामे विजयैषिणः॥
en: Bounded up into the air, thereby filling Karna's mind with great pain. Beholding that conduct of the victory-desiring Bhima, Karna.

sa: जयद्रथस्य गोप्तारः संशयं परमं गताः॥ ततः सर्वे महाराज तव योधा जयैषिणः।
en: The protectors of Jayadratha became highly anxious (about his life). Then O mighty monarch, all your warriors desirous of victory.

sa: हतानां चापरे मध्यं द्विरदानां निलिल्यिरे॥ एवं तव बलं राजन् द्रावयित्वा धनंजयः।
en: Some hid themselves behind and under the carcasses of slain elephants. Thus causing your troop to fly, O monarch, Dhananjaya.

sa: हनिष्यामोऽर्जुनं संख्ये द्विधा कृत्वाद्य भारतीम्। तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भारद्वाजो हसन्निव॥
en: Hearing those words of his, the son of Bharadvaja, as if smiling, quickly turned round and said, “Good befall you!"

sa: न शक्यमेतत् कवचं बाणैर्भेत्तुं कथंचन। अपि वज्रेण गोविन्द स्वयं मघवता युधि॥
en: This armour cannot be penetrated by arrows. Even, O Govinda, Maghavat himself cannot penetrate it in battle with his thunderbolt.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु सव्रीडमब्रवीत् पितरं तव। अश्वत्थामा हत इति तं नाबुध्यत ते पिता॥
en: Then Bhimasena suffused with blashes of shame said to your father-"Ashvatthaman has been slain." But your father believed him not.

sa: तथा राजन् महेष्वासो जलसंधो महाबलः। सुमहत् कदनं कृत्वा हतः सात्यकिना रणे॥
en: Having wrought an immense slaughter, then the great bowman king Jalasandha of mighty strength was slain in battle by Satyaki.

sa: मनसा ध्यायतस्तस्य प्रामुखस्य कृताञ्जलेः। आजग्मुस्तानि सर्वाणि दैवतानि पृथक् पृथक् ॥ मे
en: And as he sat with joined hands facing the west with a rapt mind, there came separately all those deities.

sa: यं यं देवं त्वमेतेन मन्त्रेणावाहयिष्यसि। तस्य तस्य प्रसादेन तव पुत्रो भविष्यति॥
en: “Through the effulgence of those celestial whom you will invoke by this Mantra, offspring will be certainly begotten on you”.

sa: ततो राम महादवो देवानां प्रवरो हरः। पादाङ्गुष्ठेन तं शैलं पीडयामास लीलया॥
en: Then, O Rāma, Mahadeva foremost of the deities even Hara, as in sport pressed the mount with his great toe.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते कौरवाः सर्वे विना भीमं च पाण्डवाः। वृत्तक्रीडाविहारास्तु प्रतस्थुर्गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Here the Pandavas and the Kurus, after finishing their sports and pleasure, returned to Hastinapur without Bhima.

sa: तत एनां बलाद् राजा निजग्राह रहो गताम्। वार्यमाणस्तया देव्या विस्फुरन्त्या यथाबलम्॥
en: The king then sized her by force, but Madri, trembling in fear, resisted him to the best of her power.

sa: तत्र च मया चक्रं दृष्टं द्वादशारं षड्वैनं कुमारा: परिवर्तयन्ति तदपि किम्। पुरुषश्चापि मया दृष्टः स चाऽपि कः। अश्वश्चातिप्रमाणो दृष्टः स चाऽपि कः॥
en: I then saw a wheel, with twelve spokes, which was being continually turned by six boys. What does it mean? I also saw a man, who is he? I saw also a horse of extraordinary size, what is that horse?

sa: सह पुत्रैस्ततः कुन्ती माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। आजग्मुः सहितास्तत्र यत्र राजा तथागतः॥
en: Kunti with her sons and the sons of Madri, the Pandavas, came there where the king lay in that state.

sa: यथा समुद्रो भगवान् यथा हि हिमवान् गिरिः। ख्यातावुभौ रत्ननिधी तथा भारतमुच्यते॥
en: As the sacred Ocean, as the Himavat mountain, are both, considered as mines of precious gems, so is this Bharata.

sa: स एवमुक्त उपाध्यायं प्रत्युवाच-'भोः फेनं पिबामि यमिमे वत्सा मातृणां स्तनात्पिबन्त उद्गिरन्ति॥
en: Thus questioned he said, “I now drink the froth that the calves throw out when they suck their mother's teats."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आत्मनः सदृशं प्राज्ञं नैषोऽमन्यत कंचन। तेन दोषेण पतितस्तस्मादेव नृपात्मजः॥
en: Yudhishthira said He never thought anybody his equal in wisdom. It is for that sin that prince has dropped down.

sa: अकीर्तिरतुला लोके ध्रुवं परिभविष्यति। तथा विलपतस्तस्य परिभ्रमितचेतसः॥ अस्तमभ्यागमत् सूर्यो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत।
en: As king Dasaratha was bewailing thus with a heart wrought up with grief, the sun set and night came on.

sa: स तु तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्यात्मनो हितम्। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतः परमं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those words of Răghava fraught with his welfare, Sugrīva supremely rejoiced, said these words, informed with rapture, You hero!

sa: तस्यायं कर्मणः प्राप्तो विपाको मम शोकदः। यन्मया धार्मिकः श्रीमान्स निरस्तो विभीषणः॥
en: As I had disgraced the virtuous and graceful Vibhīşaņa, this peril producing grief, has been the consequence of my conduct.

sa: अथास्य बाणेन विदारितस्य प्रादुर्बभूवासृगजस्रमुष्णम्। स तस्य जाम्बूनदपुडचित्रो भित्त्वा ललाटं सुविराजते स्म॥
en: Severed by his arrow warm life-blood gushed out of the wound. And piercing his forehead, that golden shaft appeared beautiful.

sa: सारथिं चास्य तरसा प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्। भल्लेन शितधारेण स हतः प्रापतद् रथात्॥
en: With a sharpened spike he dispatched his charioteer to the abode of Death. Slain he fell down from the chariot.

sa: भिन्ना हि सेना नृपते दुःसंधेया भवत्युत। मौला हि पुरुषव्याघ्र किमु नानासमुत्थिताः॥
en: This remark applies to your main army, judge then about the subsidiary forces which have been raised from several sources.

sa: वाचा भीष्मश्च शाल्वश्च मम राज्ञि वसानुगौ। भविष्यतोऽनवद्याङ्गि तत् करिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
en: O Princess, both Bhishma and Shalva act up to my words and I shall accomplish this work, Do not grieve.

sa: तां प्रपतितां दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनो महाबलः। उवाच धर्मराजानं याज्ञसेनीमवेक्ष्य ह॥ नाधर्मश्चरितः कश्चिद् राजपुत्र्या परंतप। कारणं किं नु तद् ब्रूहि यत् कृष्णा पतिता भुवि॥
en: Seeing her fallen down, Bhimasena of great strength addressed king Yudhishthira the just saying, 'O scorcher of enemies, this princess never did any sinful deed. Tell us what the cause is for which Krishna has fallen down on the Earth.'

sa: तस्य तद् आज्ञापयद् राक्षसेन्द्रः परं सर्वं सचत्वरम्। लाङ्गेलेन प्रदीप्तेन रक्षोभिः परिणीयताम्॥
en: The lord of Rākşasas ordered, With his tail in flames, let this one be taken all round Lankā containing terraces.

sa: ऊरुभ्यामर्धमाग्नेयं सोमार्धं च शिवा तनुः। . आत्मनोऽर्धं तथा चाग्निः सोमोऽर्धं पुनरुच्यते॥
en: Below his two thighs the forms are fiery, the other half of his soul is fire and half the moon.

sa: ततो राजा सुशर्माणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिश्चास्य विव्याध चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Skilled in weapons, and armed with sharpened arrows, swords, shaktis and maces. Then the king pierced Susharman with ten arrows,

sa: सैन्यं द्रवति चायुष्मन् कौरवेयं समन्ततः। पश्य रोधान् रणेभग्नान् धावतो वै ततस्ततः॥
en: Behold the warriors rush in all directions deserting their ranks! But in fact you behold those heroic Panchalas and Pandavas.

sa: पूजयेद् विग्रहं यस्तु लिङ्गं चापि महात्मनः। लिङ्गं पूजयिता नित्यं महतीं श्रियमश्नुते॥
en: He that ever worships the Phallic emblem of that illustrious god, attains great prosperity even by such worship of his.

sa: भक्षयन्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा शङ्खो भ्रातरमब्रवीत्। कुतः फलान्यवाप्तानि हेतुना केन खादसि॥
en: Seeing him eating, Shankha addressed his brother, saying,-Whence have these fruits been got and for why are you eating them?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हतं दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनेन संयुगे। पाण्डवाः सृञ्जयाश्चैव किमकुर्वत संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said “Secing Duryodhana struck down in battle by Bhimasena, what, O Sanjaya did the Pandavas and the Srinjayas do?"

sa: अथ राजा स्वयमेव तुलामारुरोह। न च व्यलीकमासीद् राज्ञ एतद् वृत्तान्तं दृष्ट्वा त्रात इत्युक्त्वा प्रालीयत श्येनोऽथ राजा अब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon the king himself got on the scale; he did not feel the least grief for it. Seeing this the hawk then and there disappeared exclaiming "saved”. Thereupon the king said,

sa: गत्वा कुरुन् वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो ययुर्दारुकः केशवश्च बभ्रुश्च रामस्य पदं पतन्तः। अथापश्यन् राममनतवीर्ये वृक्षे स्थितं चिन्तयानं विविक्ते॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Then Daruka, Keshava and Vabhru left that place following Rama. They saw that hero of great energy sitting thoughtfully, reclining his back against at tree, in a solitary place.

sa: स्वर्गं मनुजशार्दूल गच्छेयं सहिता त्वया। अपत्याय च मां गच्छ त्वमेव कुरुनन्दन।॥
en: O best of men, I shall go to heaven with you. O descendant of Kuru, embrace me to beget offspring

sa: पितर ऊचुः राम राम महाभाग प्रीताः स्म तव भार्गव॥ अनया पितृभक्त्या च विक्रमेण च ते विभो। वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते किमिच्छसि महाद्युते॥
en: The Pitris said: O greatly exalted Rama, O Rama, O descendant of Bhrigu, we are pleased. O lord, with your filial piety and with your great prowess. O greatly effulgent one, be blessed. Ask the boon you desire to get.

sa: ततः कुरुश्रेष्ठमुपेत्य पौराः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुरदीनसत्त्वाः। तं ब्राह्मणाश्चाभ्यवदन् प्रसन्ना मुख्याश्च सर्वे कुरुजाडुलानाम्॥
en: Thereupon the high-souled citizens, approaching that best of Kurus, walked round him. The principal Brahmanas of Kurujangala cheerfully saluted him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वसत्सु वै द्वैतवने पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। अनुकीर्णं महारण्यं ब्राह्मणैः समपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The high-minded Pandavas while residing in the forest of Dvaita that great forest was filled with Brahmanas.

sa: लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य लङ्कायाश्चापि मर्दनम्। सफलं तस्य च श्लाघ्यमद्य कर्म हनूमतः॥
en: The praise-worthy works of Hanumān-the crossing of the deep and the devastation of Lankā, have been crowned with success today.

sa: स्थितस्तु वचने तस्य सदाहमपि पुत्रका विदुरो वापि मेधावी कुरूणां प्रवरो मतः॥
en: O son, I always follow his counsel. The greatly wise Vidura is considered to be the foremost of the Kurus.

sa: वायुः प्राणः सुखं वायुर्वायुः सर्वमिदं जगत्॥ वायुना संपरित्यक्तं न सुखं विन्दते जगत्। अद्यैव च परित्यक्तं वायुना जगदायुषा॥ अद्यैव ते निरुच्छ्वासाः काष्ठकुड्योपमाः स्थिताः।
en: Therefore the wind constitutes the life, the happiness and the whole universe. Renouncing the wind the world cannot attain to happiness. Being cast off by the wind and having their breaths obstructed, behold, the world, today appear like dried wood.

sa: श्रिया जुष्टः पृषुयशाः स कुमारवरस्तदा। निषण्णो दृश्यते भूतैः पौर्णमास्यां यथा शशी॥
en: When he became thus possessed of the goddess of wealth, that illustrious and delicate being looked like the full moon.

sa: सूर्य उवाच वेदाहं सर्वमेवैतद्यदुर्वासा वरं ददौ। संत्यज्य भयमेवेह क्रियतां संगमो मम॥
en: The Sun said: I know Durvasa has given you this boon. Cast off your fears and allow me your embrace.

sa: न कुर्वन्ति वचो मह्यं कुरवः कालनोदिताः। निर्गच्छध्वं पाण्डवेयाः पुष्येण सहिता मया॥
en: Urged by fate, the Kauravas have disregarded my words. Come, O sons of Pandu, with me, under the constellation Pushya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तु शिल्पिनः सर्वे अमात्यप्रवराश्च ये। विदुरश्च महाप्राज्ञो धार्तराष्ट्र न्यवेदयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon all the artizans, the principal counsellors and the highly wise Vidura thus spoke to Dhritarashtra's son.

sa: शिशुपाल इवास्माकं गतिः स्यान्नात्र संशयः। सपनेनावहासो मे स मां दहति भारत॥
en: Our fate will be certainly as that of Shishupala. O descendant of Bharata, that insult by the enemy burns me.

sa: अब्रवीत् तव पुत्रं स सामपूर्वमिदं वचः। किं त्वं दुर्योधनैवं मां वाक्शल्यैरपकृन्तसि॥
en: Coolly addressed these words to your son "Why, O Duryodhana, are you piercing me with these harrowing words of yours'

sa: सदा च वायवो वान्ति नित्यं वर्षति वासवः। स्तनयित्नोश्च निर्घोषः श्रूयते बहुशस्तथा॥
en: The winds always blow and Indra always showers rain and the roar of the clouds may be heard many times.

sa: अहं वा कुम्भकर्णो वा त्वं वा सेनापतिर्यम। इन्द्रजिद्धा निकुम्भो वा वहेयुर्भारमीदृशम्॥
en: And this strain must be borne by these versed in warfare-me or Kumbhakarna or you-my general or Indrajit or Nikumbha.

sa: लुब्धक उवाच कारणं यदि न स्याद् वै न कर्ता स्यास्त्वमप्युत। विनाशकारणं त्वं च तस्माद् वध्योऽसि मे मतः॥
en: The fowler said If you are neither the principal cause nor the agent in this matter: you are still the cause of the death. Therefore, I think you should be killed.

sa: एते पञ्चदश ब्रह्मन् गुणा भूतेषु पञ्चसु। वर्तन्ते सर्वभूतेषु येषु लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: O Brahmana, these fifteen fifteen properties inherent in five elements, exist in all substances of which this universe is composed.

sa: वनस्पतेरपक्वानि फलानि प्रचिनोति यः। स नाप्नोति रसं तेभ्यो बीजं चास्य विनश्यति॥
en: He who plucks unripe fruits from tress, dose not get juice out of it; and moreover he destroys the seed.

sa: धृतिं कृत्वा सुविपुलां राजपुत्र रथे मम। युध्यमानस्य समरे हयान् संयच्छ शत्रुहन्।॥
en: Stationed on my car, call up your great energy, O prince. Restrain my horses in battle, O slayer of enemies.

sa: सौहृदात् सर्वभूतानां विश्वासो नाम जायते। तस्मात् सत्सु विशेषेण विश्वासं कुरुते जनः॥
en: And friendship alone generates the confidence among all creatures. It is therefore that people repose confidence specially in the virtuous.

sa: प्रसादनं पाण्डवस्य प्राप्तकालं हि रोचते। उत्तरां च प्रयच्छामि पार्थाय यदि मन्यसे॥
en: Methinks, the time has come to propitiate the Pandavas. If you like I shall confer Uttara (my daughter) upon Arjuna.

sa: राजपुत्र हितप्रेप्सुः क्षिप्रं निर्याहि च स्वयम्। त्वां हि मत्स्यो महीपाल: शून्यपालमिहाकरोत्॥
en: If you wish your well-being, speedily go out yourself, O prince. The emperor Matsya left you alone in the city.

sa: किं पुनर्मम दुष्पुत्रैः क्लिष्टः सम्प्रति पाण्डवः। निष्ठुरो रोषणोऽत्यर्थं भज्येतापि न संनमेत्। तदैव न हताः पुत्रा मम मनस्विना। तिर्यक्प्रेक्षी संहतभूः कथं शाम्येद् वृकोदरः॥
en: How can that son of Pandu do so now having been wronged by my wicked sons. Cruel and wrathful, he could not bend even when broken. Looking at things ask once, with his eyebrows contracted how can Vrikodara be peaceful.

sa: अविक्रयं लवणं पक्वमन्त्रं दधि क्षीरं मधु तैलं घृतं चा तिला मांसं फलमूलानि शाकं रक्तं वासः सर्वगन्धा गुणाश्च॥
en: Salt, cooked-food, curds, milk, honey, oil, clarified butter, sesame, flesh, fruits and roots, herbs and vegetables, red cloths, all sorts of perfumery and molasses must not be sold (by a Brahmana).

sa: जयो जयन्तो विजयो जयत्सेनो जयद्बलः। इति गुह्यानि नामानि चक्रे तेषां युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: (In order to live incognito) Yudhishthira selected for himself and his brothers these false names-Jaya, Jayanta, Vijaya, Jayatsena and Jayadbala.

sa: आर्जवं प्रतिपद्यस्व मा बाल्याद् बहु नीनशः। राजन् पुत्रांश्च पौत्राश्च सुहृदश्चैव सुप्रियान्॥
en: Be simple-minded. Do not out of childishness destroy, o king, your sons and grandsons and good and dearly beloved friends.

sa: एता घोरं शिवा नादान दिशं दक्षिणपश्चिमाम्। आस्थाय विरुवन्त्युचाः कम्पयन्त्यो मनो मम॥
en: Jackals of frightful appearance stationed in the south and east have set up terrible howls which make my heart tremble.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा धुमत्सेनो विरराम महामनाः। तिष्ठन्ती चैव सावित्री काष्ठभूतेव लक्ष्यते॥
en: Markandeya said : Saying this, the high-minded Dyumatsena ceased; and Savitri thus remaining (without food) looked like a wooden doll.

sa: योऽयं वहति मे पार्णि दक्षिणामभितः स्थितः। बलाहकादपि मतः स जवे वीर्यवत्तरः॥
en: This fourth, yoked to the rear pole on the right, is considered superior to Balahaka in both speed and strength.

sa: अभिमन्युर्महाबाहुः पुत्रो मम विशाम्पते। जामाता तव युक्तो वै भर्ता च दुहितुस्तव॥
en: O king, my son is the mighty-armed Abhimanyu. He is a proper son-in-law for you and husband for you daughter.

sa: बुबुधे तं तु सक्रोधं पितरं राक्षसेश्वरः। कुबेरस्तत्प्रसादार्थं यतते स्म सदा नृप॥
en: Knowing that his sire was angry with him, Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas, always tried to please him, O king.

sa: तस्य तं निनदं श्रुत्वा सम्प्रावेपन्त धन्विनः। वाहनानि च सर्वाणि शकृन्मूत्रे प्रसुस्रुवुः॥
en: Hearing that shout of his, the bowmen trembled (with fear); and the animals in the army passed urine and dung.

sa: यथा वज्रेण वै दीर्ण पर्वतस्य महच्छिरः। व्यतिकीर्णाः प्रदृश्यन्ते तथा सूता महीतले॥
en: The Suta's are to be seen scattered on the surface of the earth like huge mountain summits clapped by thunder-bolt.

sa: सा तामुवाच राजेन्द्र सैरन्ध्यहमुपागता। कर्म चेच्छाम्यहं कर्तुं तस्य यो मां युयुक्षति॥
en: O king, she said to her “I am a Sairandhri, I desire to do his work who will maintain me.'

sa: सावित्र्युवाच ममानपत्यः पृथिवीपतिः पिता भवेत् पितुः पुत्रशतं तथौरसम्। कुलस्य सन्तानकरं च यद् भवेत् तृतीयमेतद् वरयामि ते वरम्॥
en: Savitri said: My royal father is childless. Let him have one hundred sons, begotten by him, who will perpetuate his family. This is the third boon that I ask of you.

sa: मालिनीत्येव मे नाम स्वयं देवी चकार सा। साहमद्यागता देवि सुदेष्णे त्वन्निवेशनम्॥
en: Draupadi herself called me by name Malini, O lady Sudeshna, I, her serving maid, have come to your house today.

sa: एकः पापानि कुरुते फलं भुङ्क्ते महाजनः। भोक्तारो विप्रमुच्यन्ते कर्ता दोषेण लिप्यते॥
en: One man dose wicked deeds while the fruit is enjoyed by many; others enjoy while the doer alone is blamed.

sa: त्वं पुनः पण्डितो भूत्वा वाचं वक्तुमिहेच्छसि॥ वैरान्तकरणो जिष्णुर्न नः शेषं करिष्यति॥
en: Appearing as a learned man you are making speeches, but will not Bibhatsu, the slayer of enemies, exterminate us all?

sa: राजा चरति चेद् धर्मं देवत्वायैव कल्पते। स चेदधर्मं चरति नरकायैव गच्छति॥
en: And if the king practices virtue he resembles the god even and if he practices vice he goes to hell.

sa: तेन ते सह शक्रेण संधिर्भवतु नित्यदा। एवं विश्वासमागच्छ मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरन्यथा।॥
en: Let there be peace, to eternity, with Indra; come to entertain faith in him; let not your opinion be otherwise.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स विनिष्क्रम्य भगिन्या वचनात् तदा। सुरामाहारयामास राजाहाँ सुपरिष्कृताम्॥
en: Thus addressed he, in pursuance of his sister's words, came out and procured very fine wines worthy of a king.

sa: यत् तत् कर्णो मन्यते पारणीयं युद्धे गृहीतायुधमर्जुनं वै। आसंश्च युद्धानि पुरा महान्ति कथं कर्णो नाभवद् द्वीप एषाम्॥
en: Karna considers Arjuna capable of being vanquished when the latter takes up his weapons in battle. In former days there were many great battles. Why were they not benefited by Karna.

sa: इत्येवं वानरेन्द्रास्ते समाजग्मुः सहस्रशः। दिशस्तिस्रो विचित्याथ न तु ये दक्षिणां गताः॥
en: Thousands of monkeys 3oon began to return after searching, the three quarters, excepting those who were sent towards the south.

sa: स जज्ञे विश्रवा नाम तस्यात्मार्धेन वै द्विजः। प्रतीकाराय सक्रोधस्ततो वैश्रवणस्य वै॥
en: Thereupon for wrecking vengeance on Vaishravana in great anger that regenerate one, with half of his own self, created Vaishravana.

sa: दुर्वासा उवाच वरं वरय भद्रं ते यत् मनसि वर्तते। मयि प्रीते तु यद् धर्म्य नालभ्यं विद्यते तव॥
en: Durvasa said: You may ask from me whatever you desire to possess. Be blessed. I am pleased with you, you may obtain from me anything that is not opposed to religion.

sa: त्वय्येव तावत् तिष्ठन्तु हया इत्युक्तवान् द्विजः। प्रययौ कन्यया सार्धं दिवोदासं प्रजेश्वरम्॥
en: "Let the horse remain with you for the present, in company with the maiden, to Divodasa, the ruler of men.

sa: नेमे जातु न युध्येरन्निति मे धीयते मतिः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु नृपतेर्वाक्यं त्वरितमानसः।
en: Cannot fight, I can not lead myself to believe.” Hearing those words of the king, who was anxiously hurrying on,

sa: यदैव लभते वीरः सुयुद्धेन महद् यशः। तदैव प्रव्यथन्तेऽस्य शत्रवो विनमन्ति च॥
en: When a hero obtains great renown in fair fight then do his enemies feel pain and bow down to him.

sa: एषामभ्यधिका मासाः पञ्च च द्वादश क्षपाः। त्रयोदशानां वर्षाणामिति मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: I think, calculating in this way, there will be an addition of five months and twelve nights within thirteen vears.

sa: अहमेतद् ब्रवीम्येवं राजा चैव प्रशंसति। अर्जुनो नैव युद्धार्थी भूयसी हि दयाऽर्जुने॥
en: I say this; and the king approves of this. Arjuna is never for war; there is great kindness in Arjuna.

sa: पुनर्जघान पार्श्वे वै तद् रक्षो लक्ष्मणो भृशम्। गतासुरपतद् भूमौ कबन्धः सुमहांस्ततः॥
en: Then Lakshmana again and again smote him in his sides and the huge headless monster fell dead on the ground.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा कीर्तयन्ती दुःखानि भीमसेनस्य भामिनी। सरोद् शनकैः कृष्णा भीमसेनमुदीक्षती॥
en: Vaishampayana said Narrating her woes to Bhimasena, O Bharata, the lady Krishna wept silently with her glance fixed on Bhimasena.

sa: धर्माश्च तत्र सर्वैस्तु सेविताश्च द्विजातिभिः। स्वैः स्वैर्गुणैश्च संयुक्ता अस्मिन् वर्षे त्रयोदश॥
en: In those places, religious duties are observed by twice-born ones endued with all their respective qualities in this thirteenth year.

sa: जहषुश्च सुराः सर्वे शक्रं दृष्ट्वा विनिःसृतम्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं वृत्रवासवयोः पुनः॥
en: And seeing Shakra come out the gods all became joyful and then Vritra and Vasava again engaged themselves is fight.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अनुज्ञातः पाण्डवेन प्रययौ संजयस्तदा। शासनं धृतराष्ट्रस्य सर्वं कृत्वा महात्मनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Sanjaya, permitted by the son of Pandu, depart, doing all the behest's of the great-souled Dhritarashtra.

sa: ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं दारुकेण प्रचोदिताः। हया जग्मुर्महावेगा मनोमारुतरंहसः॥ प्रमूढा पृथिवी सर्वा
en: The horses being urged by Daruka went along with the speed of a wink, drinking as it were the sky.

sa: समयं रक्षमाणानां भार्या वो न भविष्यति। भार्यायां रक्ष्यमाणायां प्रजा भवति रक्षिता॥
en: You, who are trying to keep your pledge, will lose your wife; wife being protected, one's offspring will be protected.

sa: यम उवाच ददानि तेऽहं तमनिन्दिते वरं यथा त्वयोक्तं भविता च तत् तथा। तवाध्वना ग्लानिमिवोपलक्षये निवर्त गच्छस्व न ते श्रमो भवेत्॥ सुरेश भूयश्च
en: Yama said: O blameless girl, I give you this boon, that, what you have asked of me, will take place. I see you are wearied with your journey. Do not proceed further. Go back. Do not take any more trouble.

sa: रथी शरी चारुतली निषङ्गी शङ्खी पताकी कवची किरीटी। खड्गी च धन्वी च विभाति पार्थः शिखी वृतः स्रुग्भिरिवाज्यसिक्तः॥
en: Possessed of chariot and shafts, beautiful gloves and quivers, conch, flag, armour; and adorned with a crest, scimitar and bow Partha shines like fire fed with clarified butter and sacrificial laddles.

sa: तस्मान्न भवता चिन्ता कार्येषा स्यात् कथंचन। दैवेष्वपेक्षका ह्येते शश्वद् भावेषु भारत॥
en: Therefore should anxiety never be indulged in by you, for the gods incline towards objects worthy of them, O Bharata.

sa: स चाप्येनं तदा भीमः प्रतिजग्राह वीर्यवान्। तमाक्षिपत् कीचकोऽथ बलेन बलिनां वरः॥
en: Then the powerful Bhima seized Kichaka, and Kichaka too, the foremost of the strong, again threw him down with force.

sa: तलाभ्यां स तु भीमेन वक्ष्स्यभिहतो बली। कीचको रोषसंतप्तः पदान्न चलितः पदम्॥
en: Slapped on the breast by the powerful Bhima, Kichaka worked up with anger, did not move for a single step.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच राजपुत्रैः परिवृतस्तथा भृत्यैश्च संजय। उपारोप्य रथे कर्णं निर्यातो मधुसूदनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Surrounded by princes and by dependents, O Sanjaya, did Madhusudana (Krishna) go away making Karna ascend his chariot.

sa: अग्निरुवाच योऽसौ विश्रवसः पुत्रो दशग्रीवो महाबलः। अवध्यो वरदानेन कृतो भगवता पुरा॥
en: The highly powerful, ten-headed son of Vishrava cannot be slain for the boon, that was given him before by you.

sa: अन्येषु च नरेन्द्रेषु पराक्रम्य समारभे। अहं वैकर्तनः कर्णो भ्राता दुःशासनश्च मे॥
en: Nor on the other kings. Myself, Karna the son of Vikartana and my brother Dushasana by our prowess will win.

sa: कतमद् द्वैरथं युद्धं यत्राजैषीर्धनंजयम्। नकुलं सहदेवं वा धनं येषां त्वया हतम्॥
en: In what single combat did you ever defeat Dhananjaya, Nakula or Sahadeva although you have robbed them of their riches?

sa: तावाश्रमान् नदीश्चैव वनानि च सरांसि च। तस्यां निशि विचिन्वन्तौ दम्पती परिजग्मतुः॥
en: The (old) couple, at that night walked about searching (for their son) in all the hermitages, rivers, woods and lakes.

sa: नारद उवाच विवस्वानिव तेजस्वी बृहस्पतिसमो मतौ। महेन्द्र इव वीस्थ वसुधेव समन्वितः॥
en: Narada said: He is energetic as Vibhavasu (the sun), wise as Brihaspati, heroic as Mahendra and forgiving as the earth.

sa: प्रणिधानेन धैर्येण रूपेण वयसा च मे। मनः प्रविष्टो देवर्षे गुणकेश्याः पतिर्वरः॥
en: By his intelligence, patience, beauty and age is my heart attracted, O divine Rishi. He will make husband for Gunakeshi.

sa: अथ ये सहिता वृक्षाः सघशः सुप्रतिष्ठिताः। ते हि शीघ्रतमान् वातान् सहन्तेऽन्योन्यसंश्रयात्॥
en: But those trees that grow close together firmly can bear the force of stronger winds owing to their mutual support.

sa: नेपालविषये ये च राजानस्तानवाजयत्। अवतीर्य ततः शैलात् पूर्वां दिशमभिद्रुतः॥ अङ्गान् वङ्गान् कलिंगांश्च शुण्डिकान् मिथिलानथ मागधान् कर्कखण्डांश्च निवेश्य विषयेऽऽत्मनः॥ आवशीरांश्च योध्यांश्च अहिक्षत्रं च निर्जयत्। पूर्वां दिशं विनिर्जित्य वत्सभूमिं तथागमत्॥
en: Then coming down from the mountain and going towards the east, he vanquished the Angas and the Vargas and the Kalingas and the Shundika and the Mithilas and the Magadhas and the Karkakhandas and also the Avashiras, the Yodhyas and the Ahikshatras. Having conquered the eastern country, he went to Vatsabhumi.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तात् सावित्री भ; सत्यवता सह। आजगामाश्रमं रात्रौ प्रहृष्टा प्रविवेश ह॥
en: A moment after, Savitri accompanied by her husband Satyavana arrived at the asylum during the night and entered it cheerfully.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धर्म एव हतो हन्ति धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः। तस्माद् धर्मं न त्यजामि मा नो धर्मो हतोऽवधीत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said: He who sacrifices virtue is himself destroyed. And he that preserves it is himself preserved. I therefore, do not sacrifice virtue, considering that if destroyed it will destroy us.

sa: नैव बाष्पविमोक्षेण न वा श्वासकृते न च॥ न दीर्घरुदितेनायं पुनर्जीवं गमिष्यति।
en: Neither the shedding of tears, nor the heaving of long sighs, nor profuse lamentations, will restore this one to life.

sa: राहुग्रस्तस्य सोमस्य यथा ज्योत्स्ना न भासते। तथा तमोऽभिभूतानां भूतानां नश्यते सुखम्॥
en: The happiness of creatures that are possessed by Darkness disappears like the cffulgence of the Moon when possessed by Rahu.

sa: ततोऽगच्छत् विस्मयं ते दानवेन्द्रा भयं तथा। संशयं गतमात्मानं मेनिरे च सहस्रशः॥
en: At this they were stricken with wonder and fear. Numbering in thousands, they thought that their last hour had come.

sa: यादृशं वपते बीजं क्षेत्रमासाद्य कर्षकः। सुकृते दुष्कृते वापि तादृशं लभते फलम्॥
en: According to the good or bad seed that the husbandman sows in his field, he reaps good or bad fruits.

sa: भीम उवाच पुनरेव तु पप्रच्छ जनको मिथिलाधिपः। पराशरं महात्मानं धर्मे परमनिश्चयम्॥
en: Daksha said Once again Janaka, the king of Mithila, asked the great Parashara gifted with certain knowledge regarding all duties.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विरेमतुस्तु तद् वाक्यमुक्त्वा तावश्विनोः सुतौ। भीमसेनस्तदा वाक्यमिदं वक्तुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Vaishampayana continued After having said these words, the twin son of the Ashvins remained silent. Then Bhimasena began to say.

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः प्रादुरासीद् यदि दद्यामहं धनम्। तुष्टः कस्यचिदेवेह मिथ्यावाङ् न भवेन्मम॥
en: He then thought, saying to himself,-If, being pleased with anybody I give him riches, my speech would never be untrue.

sa: धर्मे च श्रद्दधानस्य तपस्युग्रे च वर्ततः। कालेन महता तस्य दिव्या दृष्टिरजायत॥
en: Devoted to virtue and engaged in the practice of the severest austerities, after a long time he gained spiritual vision.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया वै मुनिसत्तम। फलं पुरुषकारस्य सदा संदृश्य तत्त्वतः॥
en: best of ascetics, I have thus described all the merits of personal Exertion, having always known in their true significance.

sa: अपाकृता ततः शक्र त्वयि वत्स्यामि वासवा अप्रमत्तेन धार्यास्मि तपसा विक्रमेण च॥
en: Leaving him I shall henceforth, O Shakra, live in you! You should bear me vigilantly, and with penances and prowess.

sa: कृत्वाऽऽत्मस्थानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। एकाकी विद्यया सार्धं विहरिष्ये जगत् पुनः॥
en: Having withdrawn all creatures, mobile and immobile, into myself, I shall exist all alone with Knowledge only as my companion.

sa: स तं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा त्रिः शैलं चोत्तरामुखः। समेन भूमिभागेन ययौ प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः॥
en: Having gone round that mountain thrice, the Rishi with face turned towards the north, went on with a joyous heart.

sa: यैः कश्चित् सम्मतो लोके गुणैः स्यात् पुरुषो नृषु। भवत्यनपगान् सर्वांस्तान् गुणाल्लँक्षयामहे॥
en: O king, I see all those qualities permanently living in you by which a person acquires the esteem of all.

sa: दुर्गस्त्वेष मतः पन्था ब्राह्मणानां विपश्चिताम्। यः कश्चिद् व्रजति ह्यस्मिन् क्षेमेण भरतर्षभ॥
en: This high path of learned Brahmanas is highly difficult to tread. No one can walk along this path with ease.

sa: अनिष्टानि च भाग्यानि जातानि सह मूर्तिना। येन गच्छति बालोऽयं दत्त्वा शोकमनन्तकम्॥
en: Death is born with the body. It is for ill-luck that this boy has departed, plunging you into infinite grief!

sa: एतद् व्रतं मम सदा हृदि सम्परिवर्तते। गृहस्थानां च सुश्रोणि नातिथेर्विद्यते परम्॥
en: O beautiful one, I always remember this vow, since for householders, there is no higher virtue than hospitality to guests.

sa: अतीतानागतं चैव वर्तमानं च यद् विभो। जानीयामिति मे बुद्धिः प्रसादात् सुरसत्तम॥
en: O best of the gods, let me through your grace, have knowledge of the Present, the Past, and the Future.

sa: यस्य त्रैवार्षिकं भक्तं पर्याप्तं भृत्यवृत्तये। अधिकं चापि विद्येत स सोमं पातुमर्हति॥
en: That Brahmana who has sufficient stores for feeding his family for three or more years, deserves to drink the Soma.

sa: यश्च मे दक्षिणं बाहुं चन्दनेन समुक्षयेत्। सव्यं वास्यापि यस्तक्षेत् समावेतावुभौ मम॥
en: I regard both person impartially, viz., him who smears my right hand with sandal-paste and him who wounds my left.

sa: अथ येषां पुनः पाणी देवदत्तौ दशाङ्गुली। उद्धरन्ति कृमीनङ्गाद् दशतो निकषन्ति च॥
en: Those who have got two hands with ten fingers, can throw away or crush the worms that bite their limbs.

sa: दुर्भिक्षादेव दुर्भिक्षं क्लेशात् क्लेशं भयाद् भयम्। मृतेभ्यः प्रमृतं यान्ति दरिद्राः पापकारिणः॥
en: Sinful men are born as poor men and suffer again and again the pangs of fainine, woe, fear, and death.

sa: श्रूयते च महाराज संप्राप्ता वासवेन वै। ब्रह्मवध्या ततः शुद्धिं हयमेधेन लब्धवान्॥
en: O king! It is listen to that Indra have got relieved from the sin of Brahmanicide by celebrating a Horse-sacrifice.

sa: यदेव कर्म केवलं पुरा कृतं शुभाशुभम्। तदेव पुत्र सार्थिकं भवत्यमुत्र गच्छतः॥
en: Only those deeds, good and bad, that one did before death follow the man who goes to the other world.

sa: अथ श्वेतां गतिं गत्वा वायव्यं सूक्ष्ममप्युत। अशुक्लं चेतसः सौक्ष्यमप्युक्तं ब्राह्मणस्य वै॥
en: Then having gained whiteness, and the subtility of air, the Brahman's soul attains the supreme whiteness and subtilety of Ether.

sa: प्रयत्ने कर्मणि बले य एकस्त्रिषु वर्तते। उदान इति तं प्राहुरध्यात्मविदुषो जनाः॥
en: That single vital air which works in these three, is called Udana by those who are wellread in this science.

sa: एतानि पुरुषव्याघ्र साधुभ्यो देहि नित्यदा। दानानि हि नरं पापान्मोक्षयन्ति न संशयः॥
en: O king, do you always make such gifts, to the righteous. Forsooth, gifts rescue the giver from all his sins.

sa: अग्न्याधेये यद् भवति यच्च सोमे सुते द्विज यच्चेतरैर्महायज्ञैर्वेद तद् भगवान् पुनः॥
en: You know, O worshipful Brahmana, what are the fruits of Agnihotra, of the Somasacrifice, and of the other great sacrifices.

sa: त्यक्त्वा ज्ञातिजनं सीते मानवृद्धिं च मानिनि। अवरुद्धं वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमनुगच्छसि॥
en: O Sita, having left your kindred, and banishing pride, you have o honoured lady, followed Rāma staying in the woods.

sa: यन्नावगच्छत् सुग्रीवं वालिनं वापि राघवः। ततो न कृतवान् बुद्धिं मोक्तुमुन्तकरं शरम्॥
en: And Rāghava did not discharge that mortal shaft until he could perfectly ascertain who was Vāli and who was Sugriva.

sa: कच्चित्ते कुशलं राजन् कच्चिद् धर्मेण रञ्जयन्। प्रजाः पालयसे राजन् राजवृत्तेन धार्मिक॥
en: O king, is it well with you? And, O king, do you rule your subjects pleasing them consistently with morality?

sa: येषां चाराश्च कोशश्च लयश्च जयतां वर। अस्वाधीना नरेन्द्राणां प्राकृतैस्ते जनैः समाः॥
en: O you best of conquerors, those kings whose spies, exchequer and morality are not free, are like the common head.

sa: यवीयान् स मम भ्राता जटायुर्नाम वानराः। यमाख्यात हतं युद्ध रावणेन बलीयसा॥
en: You monkeys, you have said that my younger brother, named Jaţāyu, has been slain in battle by the powerful Rāvaņa.

sa: यथा रामे तथा तस्मिन् सर्वा ववृतिरे स्त्रियः। वृत्तिं दशरथाज्जाते लक्ष्मणे शुभलक्षणे॥
en: Thereat, as they had treated Rāma, all the ladies treated that one sprung from Daśaratha, Laksmana, graced with auspicious marks.

sa: स्वागतं तव चेत्युक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। आसनं चास्य भगवान् वसिष्ठो व्यादिदेश ह॥
en: Having enquired as to the pleasantness of Viśvāmitra's journey, the high-souled and adorable Vasiştha ordered a seat for the former.

sa: तां तथा पतितां दृष्ट्वा विरूपां शोणितोक्षिताम्। भगिनीं क्रोधसंतप्तः शरः पप्रच्छ राक्षसः॥
en: Seeing his sister deformed, and covered with blood, fallen on the ground, the Raksasa, Khara, fired with wrath asked her.

sa: तस्थुरेकान्तमाश्रित्य सर्वे शोकपरायणाः। ततस्तारा पतिं दृष्ट्वा शिबिकातलशायिनम्॥ आरोप्याङ्के शिरस्तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता।
en: And Tārā, beholding her husband's body on the conveyance, placed his head on her lap and bewailed, overwhelmed with griet.

sa: ततस्ते कारणं सर्वं तथा शापं च वालिनः। शशंसुर्वानराः सर्वे वालिने हेममालिने॥
en: Thereupon they related to Vāli, wearing a golden garland, the cause of the Saint's curse by him and other monkeys.61

sa: विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाणः पुत्रः प्रतापवान्। बाणस्य तु महातेजा अनरण्यः प्रतापवान् ॥
en: And Vikuksi's son was the exceedingly energetic and powerful Bāņa. And Bāna's son was the highly energetic and powerful Anaranya.

sa: नैषा हि सा स्त्री भवति श्लाघनीयेन धीमता। उभयोर्लोकयोर्लोके पत्या या सम्प्रसाद्यते॥
en: She cannot be reckoned a gentlewoman, who is propitiated by her intelligent husband, worthy of being extolled in both worlds.

sa: पुत्रः किल जवस्याहं माता मम शतहदा। विराध इति मामाहुः पृथिव्यां सर्वराक्षसाः॥
en: I am son of Java, and my mother is Satahradā. All the Rāksasas of the earth have called me Virādha.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा प्राक्षिपद् राजा मन्त्रपूतं जलं तदा। साधुसाध्विति देवानामृषीणां वदतां तदा ॥
en: Saying this, the king sprinkled Rāma's palm with water sanctified with mantras; with the celestials and saints exclaiming, Excellent! Excellent!

sa: येभ्यः प्रणमसे पुत्र देवेष्वायतनेषु च। ते च त्वामभिरक्षन्तु वने सह महर्षिभिः॥
en: Let the deities, whom you worship every day in the temple, together with the Maharsis protect you in the forest.

sa: मा रुदो मा रुदश्चेति गर्भं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत। विभेद च महातेजा रुदन्तमपि वासवः॥
en: 'Do not cry, do not cry,' exclaimed Sakra: and even while it was crying, the mighty-minded Vāsava continued piercing it.

sa: सदृशं खलु वो वाक्यमङ्गदो यदुवाच ह। हितं चैवानुकूलं च क्रियतामस्य भाषितम्॥
en: What Angada has said to us is worthy of him, and is beneficial and good. Do you follow his speech.

sa: बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणां मम योऽसौ परिग्रहः। तासां त्वमीश्वरी सीते मम भार्या भव प्रिये॥
en: O Sītā, be you the mistress of those numerous excellent women who are my wives. Dear, be you my wife.

sa: धिगस्तु योषितो नाम शठाः स्वार्थपरायणाः। न ब्रवीमि स्त्रियः सर्वा भरतस्यैव मातरम्॥
en: Fie upon women, crafty and selfish! But I must not name all women, I mean only the mother of Bharata.

sa: अतिथिः किल पूजार्हः प्राकृतोऽपि विजानता। धर्मे जिज्ञासमानेन किं पुनर्यादृशो भवान् ॥
en: Even an ordinary guest should be adored by him who abide by virtue, what of you great as you are?

sa: स लक्ष्मणः कृष्णमृगं हत्वा मेध्यं प्रतापवान्। अथ चिक्षेप सौमित्रिः समिद्धे चातवेदसि॥
en: Then Lakşmana the son of Sumitrā endowed with vigour, having slain a sacred black deer, threw it into flaming fire.

sa: कथं दशरथाज्जातो भवेद् राज्यापहारकः। राज्यं चाहं च रामस्य धर्म वक्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
en: How begot of Dasaratha, shall I deprive Rāma of his kingdom. It behove you to speak righteousness before this assembly.

sa: या न शक्या पुरा द्रष्टुं भूतैराकाशगैरपि। तामद्य सीतां पश्यन्ति राजमार्गगता जनाः॥
en: And that Sītā whom formerly the very rangers of the sky could not see, is to-day beheld by the passers-by.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततोऽहं तैः सिद्धैः परमशोभनैः। स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसां प्रतिवेदितः॥
en: Then those eminently handsome Siddhas spoke thus to me.-This is Ravana, the king of the Rākşasas, said they to me.

sa: यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः॥ श्रमं नावाप्नुयात् किंचिदप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु। दारुणश्चाप्ययं शोको यथैनं न विनाशयेत्॥ राज्ञो वृद्धस्य सततं हितं चर समाहिता।
en: Do you now take care that on my retiring the monarch does not wear away by the pangs of my separation, that this terrible sorrow may not kill him. Do you look after the welfare of the old king always.

sa: एकस्याः खलु कैकेय्याः कृतेऽयं खिद्यते जनः। स्वार्थ प्रयतमानायाः संश्रित्य निकृतिं त्विमाम्॥
en: These people are in trouble in consequence of Kaikeyi alone striving by help of this craftiness to secure her interest.

sa: मया च रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन प्रशास्तु हीनो भरतस्त्वया सह। पुरं च राष्ट्रं च निहत्य बान्धवान् ममाहितानां च भवाभिभाषिणी॥
en: Now dissevered from me, and Rāma together with Lakşmaņa, let Bharata govern the city and the kingdom along with you. Destroying your relatives, do you enhance the joy of my enemies.

sa: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यं मया गुरुजनाज्ञया। त्वद्वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यमिह जीवितुम्॥
en: I shall follow you, taking the permission of the respected ones, without you, O, Rāma, I will renounce my life.

sa: उक्तवाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् मुनिपन्यां तथैव च। शुन:शेपः स्वयं राम मध्यमो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And when the ascetic as well as his wife had spoken thus, the second son, Sunahsepa, O Rāma, himself said.

sa: तेन सख्यं च कर्तव्यं न्याय्यवृत्तेन राघव। कल्पयिष्यति ते वीर साहाय्यं लघुविक्रम॥
en: O Raghava, O fleet-footed hero, do you contract friendship with him gifted with good qualities and he shall assist you.

sa: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् तात सर्वेषामपि रक्षसाम्। अपि रामो न संक्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकानराक्षसान्॥
en: I shall be well, me child, if Rāma fired with rage, do not render all the world bereft of Rākşasas;

sa: शतान्यथ सहस्राणि कोट्यश्च मम शासनात्। प्रयान्तु कपिसिंहानां निदेशे मम ये स्थिताः॥
en: Let those hundreds and thousands and kotis of leonine monkeys that abide by my mandate, hie (hence) at my behest.

sa: यस्या गतिरनाथायाः पुत्रः प्रव्राजितो वनम्। तामम्बां तात कौसल्यां त्यक्त्वात्वं व गतोनृप।७।।
en: My father, forsaking forlorn mother Kausalya, whose stay her son, had gone to the forest, where have you gone, Oking?

sa: ततो मधुरया वाचा सौम्यया प्रीणयन्निव। उवाच वत्स मां विद्धि वयस्यं पितुरात्मनः॥
en: There-upon, in soft and sweet words, he, pleasing them, said, My child, know me for a friend of your father.'

sa: न वाति मारुतस्तत्र निष्प्रभोऽभूद् दिवाकरः। दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां देवो दिव्येन चक्षुषा ॥ कृतं कार्यमिति श्रीमान् व्याजहार पितामहः।
en: And the air did not breathe there; and the sun grew dim. Espying with his divine vision that Sītā was overcome, that Deity, the graceful Great-father exclaimed, Our work is accomplished.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु वा राम न भवेद् सदृशस्तव। बलामतिबलां चैव पठतस्तात राघव॥ न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धिनिश्चये। नोत्तरे प्रतिवक्तव्ये समो लोके तवानघ॥ एतद्विद्याद्वये लब्धे न भवेत् सदृशस्तव। बला चातिबला चैव सर्वज्ञानस्य मातरौ ॥
en: Do you, O Rāghava, recite Bala and Atibala, O child! And, O sinless one, when you have secured these two kinds of knowledge, none in this world will equal you in good fortune, or in talent or in philoscphic wisdom, or in subtle apprehension, or in the capacity of answering a controversialist; for Bala and Atibala are the nurses of all knowledge.

sa: पूर्वमेव मया वीर श्रुतं कथयतो वचः। अङ्गदस्य कुमारस्य वक्ष्याम्यद्य हितं वचः॥
en: Hearken, O hero, I shall relate to you today, the auspicious words, I heard ere this, from the prince Angada.

sa: सुग्रीवः क्रोधनो राजा तीक्ष्णदण्डश्च वानराः। भेतव्यं तस्य सततं रामस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: You monkeys, king Sugrīva is irascible; and inflicteth sharp punishments. He should be always feared, as also the magnanimous Rāma.

sa: सहायकृत्यं किं तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः। गिरिश्च वसुधा चैव बाणेनैकेन दारिताः॥
en: What need of assistance to him who with a single shaft rived seven giant trees, a mountain, and the Earth.

sa: स तु निर्धूय ताः सर्वा निर्जगाम महाबलः। ततोऽहमपि सौहार्दान्निःसृतो वालिना सह॥
en: But moving them aside, that exceedingly powerful one sallied out. Thereupon out of affection I also went out with Vāli.

sa: तं हि नित्यं महाराजो बलवन्तं महौजसम्। उपाश्रितोऽभूद् धर्मात्मा मेरुमैरुवनं यथा ॥
en: The monarch was ever protected by that powerful one possessed of mighty energy, as Meru is protected by its forest.

sa: व्युष्टामेव तु तां रात्रिं दृष्ट्वा तं स्वप्नमप्रियम्। पुत्रो राजाधिराजस्य सुभृशं पर्यतप्यत॥
en: And seeing that evil dream during the short hours, the son of that king of kings exceedingly burned in grief.

sa: स रामं सर्वकामैस्तं भरद्वाजः प्रियातिथिम्। सभार्यं सह च भ्रात्रा प्रतिजग्राह हर्षयन्॥
en: Bharadvāja entertained his welcome guest, Rāma, along with his wife and brother by extending towards them every rite of hospitality.

sa: मन्त्रिणां वचनं श्रुत्वा यथाभिलषितं प्रियम्। अब्रवीत् सारथिं वाक्यं रथो मे युज्यतामिति॥
en: Having heard the words of the counsellors acceptable and welcome, Bharata said to the charioteer, Do you yoke my car.

sa: आरोहतु भवान् नावं राजपुत्रपुरस्कृतः। अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः॥
en: Do you ascend the bark, with the princes at your head! May your journey be auspicious: let no delay occur

sa: जानीषे त्वं जनस्थानं भ्राता यत्र खरो मम। दूषणश्च महाबाहु स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे॥ त्रिशिराश्च महाबाहू राक्षसः पिशिताशनः। अन्ये च बहवः शूरा लब्धलक्षा निशाचराः॥ वसन्ति मनियोगेन अधिवासं च राक्षसाः। बाधमाना महारण्ये मुनीन् ये धर्मचारिणः॥
en: You know Janasthāna, where lives my brother Khara, and the mighty-armed Dusana, and my sister, sūrpanakhă; as also that Räksasa subsisting on (human) flesh, the long armed Trisirā, and many other heroic night rangers besides, of high enthusiasm in battlesRākşasas, who had been living there at my command, troubling in the mighty forest the ascetics carrying on their pious offices.

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां पुरिश्रेष्ठे काकुत्स्थपरिपालिते। दैवतानि च यानि त्वां पालयन्त्यावसन्ति च ॥
en: O best of cities, governed by Kākutstha, I address you as well as the deities that inhabit and guard you.

sa: नैव चित्रं सपत्नेषु पापं लक्ष्मण यद् भवेत्। त्वद्विधेषु नृशंसेषु नित्यं प्रच्छन्नचारिषु॥
en: It is not a wonder that an evil desire lurks in you who are a hypocrite and a cruel-hearted cnemy.

sa: कदाहं पुनरागम्य सरय्वाः पुष्पिते वने। मृगयां पर्यटिष्यामि मात्रा पित्रा च संगतः॥
en: When shall I coming back, range a hunting the blossoming groves of the Sarayū, along with my father and mother?

sa: आदित्यः सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम्। बोधयत्यद्य पृथिवीं तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्॥
en: As the sun in company with the moon enlightens the fair earth containing creatures, so do I to-day enlighten you.

sa: अप्सरःसु च मुख्यासु गन्धर्वीणां यक्षपन्नगकन्यासु ऋक्षविद्याधरीषु च ॥ किन्नरीषां च गात्रेषु वानरीणां तनूषु च। सृजध्वं हरिरूपेण पुत्रांस्तुल्यपराक्रमान्॥
en: And from forth the bodies of the foremost Apsaras, Gandharvis, Yaksis, and Pannagis, Rks is (She-bears) and Vidhyādharis, Kinnaris and Vānaris (She-monkeys) do you produce sons wearing the shapes of monkeys.

sa: ननु नामाविनीतानां विनेतासि परंतप। कथमेवंविधं पापं न त्वं शाधि हि रावणम्॥
en: O you the subduer of foes, you did always control the rebellious,-why do you not punish such a vicious Rākşasa?

sa: मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव। कः समर्थोऽधिकं कर्तुं कृतान्तस्येव तिष्ठतः॥
en: Who can disturb the installation, Oh Rāghava, myself protecting you by your side with my bows, like to Death himself.

sa: वसिष्ठं च समागम्य कुशलं मुनिपुङ्गवः॥ ऋषींश्च तान् यथान्यायं महाभाग उवाच ह।
en: And approaching Vasiştha and the other anchorites, that foremost of ascetics of exalted piety duly asked them regarding their welfare.

sa: एतत् तु वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। उवाच रामं कौसल्या रुदती शोकलालसा॥
en: Hearing these words of the high-souled Laks maņa, Kausaly, weeping and being pressed with sorrow spoke these words to Rāma.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। हस्ते हस्तं समाहत्य चकार सुमहद् वपुः॥
en: Hearing those words of Sītā the highly powerful Ten necked one striking his hands together, increased his body too high.

sa: सुमन्त्रः करुणं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा दीनं च पार्थिवम्। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः किंचित् तस्माद् देशादपाक्रमत्॥
en: Hearing those sorrowful words and finding the lord of earth aggrieved thus, Sumantra with clasped hands went off a little.

sa: स कृत्वा निश्चयं विष्णुरामन्त्र्य च पितामहम्। अन्तर्धानं गतो देवैः पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: Then, having ascertained the course to follow, Visnu, having greeted the Grand-sire, vanished there, worshipped by deities and the Maharsis.

sa: ततस्ते यमुनां दिव्यां नदीं तीोर्मिमालिनीम्। ददृशुस्तां पुनः सर्वे गङ्गां शिवजलां नदीम्॥
en: And after having crossed the beautiful river Yamunā flowing in waves, they again beheld the river Gangā of auspicious waters.

sa: न राज्यभ्रंशनं भद्रे न सुहद्भिर्विनाभवः। मनो मे बाधते दृष्ट्वा रमणीयमिमं गिरिम्॥
en: O gentle one, neither deprivation of the kingdom nor separation from friends afflicts my mind on beholding this romantic mountain.

sa: नाथ पर्वतदुर्गेषु नदीनां पुलिनेषु च। आयुश्चिरमिदं वीर त्वं मया सह रंस्यसे॥
en: Do you sport with me, for ever, O hero, in these mountainous strongholds and on the banks of the rivers.

sa: फलानि मूलानि च भक्षयन् वने गिरीश्च पश्यन् सरितः सरांसि च। वनं प्रविश्यैव विचित्रपादपं सुखी भविष्यामि तवास्तु निर्वृतिः॥
en: Living upon fruits and roots in the forest, and surveying mountains and tanks and streams and graceful trees, I shall be happy on entering the forest. Do you cease to lament.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु वचनं बाष्पेण विहतेन्द्रियः। रामेति सकृदेवोक्त्वा व्याहर्तुं न शशाक सः॥
en: Having said these words, Dasaratha, his senses overpowered by the vapour of sorrow, exclaimed "Rāma!” and could not proceed further.

sa: काननं वापि शैलं वा यं रामोऽनुगमिष्यति । प्रियातिथिमिव प्राप्तं नैनं शक्ष्यन्त्यनर्चितुम्॥
en: And forests and hills to which will repair Rāma cannot go without paying him homage like to a welcome guest.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान् विश्वामित्रेण धीमता। न दास्यामीति शबलां प्राह राजन् कथंचन ॥
en: Thus besought by the intelligent Viśvāmitra, that adorable one replied, saying, 'Oking, Śabala I will not by any means give.'

sa: अनसूया तु धर्मज्ञा श्रुत्वा तां महती कथाम्। पर्यष्वजत् बाहुभ्यां शिरस्याघ्राय मैथिलीम्॥
en: Having heard this grand story, Anasāyā cognizant of righteousness, smelling the head of Mithilā's daughter, embraced Sītā with her arms.
